| SYSTEM | Chance = 0.02×dt×synergy per tick when BOND_COUNT ≥ 3 and ENERGY ≥ 1: break the first filled bond slot, clear the partner's reciprocal slot and decrement both counts, then ENERGY −= 0.5×dt×synergy. |
